title: Uniqueness Characterization of Fibonacci-Sum Permutations (Layman's Conjecture / Hajnal Conjecture 1)
abstract: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization proving that there exists a unique permutation p of {1, ..., k} with every i + p(i) a Fibonacci number if and only if k belongs to Layman's sequence w(n) = floor(F_{n+3} / sqrt(5)) (equivalently Hajnal's M4 sequence). Formalizes Hajnal's (2022) "only if" direction and Reshetnikov's (2015, OEIS A097083) floor formula alongside a step-lemma proof of the "if" direction (Hajnal Conjecture 1). Companion write-up and dated prior-work searches (arXiv, OEIS, zbMATH, CORE 2026-11-20, Google Scholar 2026-11-22) are published at https://mathdiscoveries.org/results/fibonacci-sum-permutations; the "if" direction was not found in those logged searches (MathSciNet and print problem sections remain unsearched).
